title: Remove and refit the stock exhaust
completeness: Complete assembled-bike stock exhaust removal and installation with new joint gaskets, staged header-nut tightening and clamp locating features. Does not dismantle or repack the silencer.

source.review_note: PDF206 and211-213 visually reviewed this pass; general/body pages previously reviewed. Exact gasket and clamp diagrams mandatory.

applicability.included: Stock US 2026 YZ450F exhaust and bodywork

required_tools.name: Stable stand and support for exhaust components
Appropriate body/exhaust sockets and calibrated torque wrench

required_parts.name: New exhaust gaskets at positions 6, 8 and 9 in PDF206
required_parts.purpose: Header-to-head and both separated pipe joints; identify the exact stock parts before starting

preflight: Stopped engine and exhaust fully cool; bike stable.
Exact stock hardware and three new joint gaskets available.
Undamaged fasteners; normal general clean/dry thread conditions unless a specific source instruction overrides.
critical_stop_conditions: Joint cannot seat or clamp locating projection cannot engage correctly.
Damaged threads, gasket seat or exhaust support.
Exhaust contacts bodywork or another component after tightening.

steps.title: Expose the exhaust mounts
steps.instruction: Release and lift the tethered sub-seat, remove the main-seat bolts and slide the seat rearward. Remove the right side-cover bolts and collars, then slide the cover out of its upper/lower locating slots. Retain all hardware by location. No fuel-system work is needed.
verification: Right side exposed; tabs and hardware retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Remove the complete silencer
steps.instruction: Support the silencer. Loosen its joint clamp, remove its two mounting bolts and lift the complete silencer off its joint. Keep the silencer body, end cap and packing assembled.
verification: Complete silencer supported and removed; internals untouched.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Remove the intermediate pipe
steps.instruction: Loosen the pipe-2 joint clamp and remove the exhaust-pipe bracket bolt while supporting the pipe. Move pipe 2 through the clearance path shown in PDF211 and remove it without forcing nearby components.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Remove the header and old seals
steps.instruction: Remove the header nuts and header pipe. Leave the header protector attached. Remove the old head gasket and the two pipe-joint gaskets; inspect joint faces and supports for damage before refitting.
verification: Header removed; all three separated joint seals identified; protector untouched.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Seat the new header gasket
steps.instruction: Install the new gasket at the head and refit header pipe 1. Tighten all header nuts first to 7 N·m, then retighten them to 10 N·m. Do not apply the protector-screw locking-agent note to these nuts.
verification: New head gasket; all header nuts 7 then 10 N·m.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Locate pipe 2 and its clamp
steps.instruction: Install the new pipe-joint gaskets in their PDF206 positions. Refit the pipe-2 clamp, pipe 2 and bracket bolt. At each joint, engage the clamp projection in the pipe/silencer slot and keep the clamp off the raised projection illustrated in PDF212. Leave final bracket and clamp tightening until the silencer is seated.
verification: Fresh joint seals seated; clamp locating features correct.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Refit the complete silencer
steps.instruction: Refit the silencer clamp and complete silencer on the seated joint. Install the retained mounting hardware and tighten both silencer mounting bolts to 30 N·m.
verification: Both silencer mounts 30 N·m; joints fully engaged.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Tighten the bracket and both clamps
steps.instruction: Confirm front and rear joints remain fully inserted while tightening the exhaust-pipe bracket bolt to 20 N·m, pipe-2 clamp bolt to 16 N·m and silencer clamp bolt to 16 N·m.
verification: Bracket 20 N·m; each joint clamp 16 N·m; projections correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Restore bodywork and check the installation
steps.instruction: Slide the right-cover tabs into their slots with its rib under the rear-fender rib; refit its collars/bolts at 7 N·m. Refit the main seat and its two bolts at 13 N·m. Secure the sub-seat quick fastener with its tether untwisted. Check exhaust support, gasket/joint seating and clearance from bodywork. Record the replaced seals and final torques; this completes removal/refit only, not silencer repacking.
verification: Body secure; supported exhaust with clearances and joint seating checked; hardware accounted for.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary with support and logging workflow adaptations.
